caption: The drawing features a single, ornate, metallic pitcher or ewer rendered in graphite pencil on a plain, light-colored background. The vessel has a tall, rounded body that narrows at the base and flares out slightly at the lip, which is designed with a pouring spout. A single, thin, elongated handle rises elegantly from the back and curves upward, attaching near the rim. The pitcher stands on a square pedestal base, which supports its weight. The surface of the pitcher is decorated with engraved patterns, including a medallion on the front surrounded by intricate motifs. The shading and detailing create the appearance of reflective metal. The artist's signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the paper.
title: Silver Tea Set Creamer
